questions.question: Dr. Abera treats patients living in remote villages using mobile consultation tools. Which option correctly converts this sentence into the Passive Voice?

options.text: Patients living in remote villages are treated by Dr. Abera using mobile consultation tools.
Patients living in remote villages were treated by Dr. Abera using mobile consultation tools.
Patients living in remote villages have been treated by Dr. Abera using mobile consultation tools.
Patients living in remote villages will be treated by Dr. Abera using mobile consultation tools.

questions.explanation: In Simple Present active sentences ('treats'), the Passive Voice transformation requires 'am/is/are + past participle' ('are treated').

questions.question: In medical vocabulary, what is the contextual definition of 'diagnosis'?

options.text: The identification of the nature and cause of an illness or disease through examination
The surgical removal of damaged internal organs
The financial cost of purchasing imported pharmaceuticals
The administrative registration of new hospital employees

questions.explanation: In Section 8A.1 and 8D.1 vocabulary, 'diagnosis' refers to identifying a medical condition or disease by analyzing symptoms and medical data.

questions.question: All regional healthcare officers attended the virtual telemedicine conference ______ Dr. Kebede, who was performing emergency surgery.
questions.explanation: 'Except' is a preposition meaning 'excluding' or 'other than'. 'Accept' is a verb meaning to receive.

questions.question: The young physician had to ______ the invitation to speak at the international medical summit because of urgent clinical duties.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'turn down' means to refuse, decline, or reject an offer or invitation.

questions.question: According to Grade 12 Unit 8, what constitutes the fundamental definition of 'telemedicine'?

options.text: The delivery of healthcare services and medical expertise over distance using information and communications technology (ICT)
The commercial sale of herbal remedies via radio broadcasts
The physical transport of rural patients by ambulance to capital cities
The manufacture of electronic diagnostic devices in local factories

questions.explanation: Section 8A.1 and 8C.1 explicitly define 'telemedicine' as utilizing ICT systems to deliver healthcare, consultation, and diagnostic services across distance barriers.

questions.question: Healthcare providers in remote rural districts usually rely ______ mobile satellite networks to consult with urban specialists.
questions.explanation: The verb 'rely' requires the specific preposition 'on' ('rely on something/someone').

questions.question: Direct speech: The specialist said, "I conducted three tele-consultations yesterday." In reported speech: The specialist said that he had conducted three tele-consultations ______.
questions.explanation: When converting direct speech into reported speech, the time adverb 'yesterday' backshifts to 'the day before' (or 'the previous day').

questions.question: The medical director paid a gracious ______ to the hospital staff for successfully managing the telemedicine pilot project.
questions.explanation: 'Compliment' (noun) means an expression of praise or admiration. 'Complement' means something that completes or brings to perfection.

questions.question: Solve the domain analogy based on Section 8D.1: DERMATOLOGY is to SKIN as RADIOLOGY is to ______.
questions.explanation: Dermatology is the medical branch specializing in skin diseases; similarly, radiology is the branch specializing in medical imaging and X-rays.

questions.question: In formal administrative and organizational meetings, what is the official written record of the proceedings, decisions, and attendance called?
questions.explanation: Section 8B.1 defines 'minutes' as the official written record summarizing what took place and what decisions were passed during a meeting.

questions.question: According to Section 8C.2 'Telemedicine in Ethiopia', which central hospital in Addis Ababa serves as the main telemedicine hub delivering tele-radiology and tele-dermatology services to regional hospitals in Gondar, Jimma, and Nekemte?
questions.explanation: Section 8C.2 highlights that Tikur Anbessa Hospital houses the primary telemedicine center, connecting specialized medical talent to regional hospital hubs.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly converts the Future Perfect Active sentence into the Passive Voice: "By the end of next year, the Ministry of Health will have established ten new tele-dermatology centers."

options.text: By the end of next year, ten new tele-dermatology centers will have been established by the Ministry of Health.
By the end of next year, ten new tele-dermatology centers will be established by the Ministry of Health.
By the end of next year, ten new tele-dermatology centers will have established by the Ministry of Health.
By the end of next year, ten new tele-dermatology centers were established by the Ministry of Health.

questions.explanation: Future Perfect Passive voice requires 'will have been + past participle' ('will have been established').

questions.question: Direct speech: The consultant stated, "We may install advanced digital radiology equipment here next week." Which reported speech conversion is GRAMMATICALLY CORRECT?

options.text: The consultant stated that they might install advanced digital radiology equipment there the following week.
The consultant stated that we may install advanced digital radiology equipment here next week.
The consultant stated that they can install advanced digital radiology equipment there the week before.
The consultant stated that they might install advanced digital radiology equipment here last week.

questions.explanation: In reported speech, modal 'may' backshifts to 'might', pronoun 'we' to 'they', place adverb 'here' to 'there', and time adverb 'next week' to 'the following week'.

questions.question: According to World Health Organization (WHO 2014) data cited in Section 8C.2, what key structural statistic underlines the urgent necessity of telemedicine in Ethiopia?

options.text: An extremely low physician-to-population density of 0.025 per 1,000 people, with most specialists concentrated in urban centers.
A complete absence of pharmaceutical imports across all regional states.
A legal prohibition against training medical doctors in public universities.
An oversupply of specialized surgeons residing exclusively in rural villages.

questions.explanation: Section 8C.2 cites the WHO physician-to-population density ratio of 0.025/1,000 in Ethiopia, demonstrating the severe urban-rural medical disparity that telemedicine bridges.

questions.question: When structuring a persuasive or argumentative essay advocating for telemedicine expansion, where should the author address potential counterarguments (such as internet connectivity constraints), and how should they handle them?

options.text: Within the body paragraphs, treating opposing views respectfully before refuting them with logical evidence and alternative technological solutions.
Inside the title, ignoring all opposing perspectives completely.
At the very beginning of the essay, insulting opponents for lacking technical knowledge.
In a separate appendix, without connecting them to the main thesis statement.

questions.explanation: Effective argumentative writing (Section 8F.1 & 8F.4) acknowledges opposing views respectfully within body paragraphs and uses solid evidence to refute them and reinforce the main thesis.
